name: bge-m3
description: Multilingual embeddings supporting 100+ languages with 8K context. State-of-the-art for cross-lingual retrieval tasks.

usage_examples.title: Embed text
usage_examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8082/embed \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "BAAI/bge-m3", "input": ["search query text"]}'
